meta.inherit_verdict: 계승 성립 — 확정 패키지가 D(계승형)이고 제목 골격과 썸네일 구도를 앵커 002에서 한 몸으로 물려받았다. 9장 규격에 따라 계승 장은 7번에 배치하고 8·9번은 우리 쪽 감정 클로즈업으로 둔다.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 국별쿼터 중국 15만 7,195톤 vs 미국 13만 2,304톤을 포대 더미 높이 차이로 보여준다. 인트로에서 심는 오픈루프 B(왜 중국이 미국보다 많나)의 시각 요약이라 내용 대표 1번으로 잡았다. 우리 쪽 인물(한국 검수원)을 세워 황당함이 시청자 쪽으로 붙게 했다.
thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the lower two-fifths of this image is one clean continuous surface — plain polished concrete warehouse floor — rendered simply and evenly with nothing on it, and every subject, character, object, effect and action is composed entirely within the upper three-fifths above it. photorealistic advertising composite, intense neon glow lighting, emissive colors spilling onto surrounding surfaces, extreme color contrast, the upper three-fifths densely packed with elements, exaggerated wide-angle perspective, hyper-saturated and eye-catching. Inside a vast dim grain warehouse two towering stacks of 20kg white rice sacks rise toward the ceiling: the left stack is visibly taller and every sack is stencilled with the Chinese flag (red field with one large yellow star and four smaller yellow stars) glowing under acid-lime work lamps, while the right stack is clearly shorter and stencilled with the US flag (red and white stripes with a blue canton of white stars) under cold cyan light. A thick glowing red neon upward arrow runs along the left stack and a smaller dim arrow along the right, the emissive red and lime light bouncing off the plastic-wrapped pallets. In the right foreground, chest-up, a Korean male warehouse inspector in a navy work jacket, hard hat and clipboard stares at the taller Chinese stack with eyes wide open showing whites, mouth agape, one hand frozen mid-air pointing at it, beads of sweat on his forehead. Overhead sodium lamps and hanging cables fill the upper frame with dense industrial detail. no text, no letters, no words, no numbers, no watermark.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 라벨은 계속 인쇄되어 나오는데 원산지 칸만 백지로 비어 있는 장면. 대본 P8(15:30~17:30) 네 개의 구멍이 근거이며, 확정 제목의 심장을 텍스트 없이 전달하는 컷이다. 검사원의 경멸 표정으로 감정 온도를 우리 쪽에 붙였다.
thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the lower two-fifths of this image is one clean continuous surface — plain polished stainless steel table top — rendered simply and evenly with nothing on it, and every subject, character, object, effect and action is composed entirely within the upper three-fifths above it. photorealistic advertising composite, intense neon glow lighting, emissive colors spilling onto surrounding surfaces, extreme color contrast, the upper three-fifths densely packed with elements, exaggerated wide-angle perspective, hyper-saturated and eye-catching. Dead centre of the frame an industrial thermal label printer spits out a long ribbon of freshly printed food labels that curls toward the camera; every label is fully printed except one rectangular field left completely blank white, and a thick bold red neon ring burns around that blank field, its glow spilling red across the steel and the operator's gloved fingers. Behind it a cold cyan-white food packaging line runs into deep wide-angle perspective, crowded with sealed rice-cake trays, puffed rice snack pouches and fluorescent tubes. On the right, chest-up, a Korean female quality inspector in a white hygiene cap, mask pulled down to her chin and blue nitrile gloves lifts the label ribbon to eye level with narrowed disdainful eyes, lips pressed tight and one corner of her mouth pulled down. The entire left half is drowned in cold cyan factory light, the right half punched with glowing red and acid-lime accents. no text, no letters, no words, no numbers, no watermark.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 식당은 밥·죽·누룽지만 원산지 표시 의무가 있고 떡·면·식혜는 제외된다는 P8의 네 번째 구멍을 배식대 하나로 보여준다. 001 댓글 7·9·10위(식당 밥 경로)가 두 레퍼에서 미답변으로 남은 지점이라 내용 대표에 넣었다.
thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the lower two-fifths of this image is one clean continuous surface — plain brushed stainless steel counter — rendered simply and evenly with nothing on it, and every subject, character, object, effect and action is composed entirely within the upper three-fifths above it. photorealistic advertising composite, intense neon glow lighting, emissive colors spilling onto surrounding surfaces, extreme color contrast, the upper three-fifths densely packed with elements, exaggerated wide-angle perspective, hyper-saturated and eye-catching. A Korean cafeteria serving line seen straight on, steam rising from deep trays: in front of the single tray of steamed white rice stands one small metal sign holder with a clean blank white card lit by warm light, while in front of the neighbouring trays of tteokbokki rice cakes, noodles and a glass jug of sikhye the identical sign holders are conspicuously empty, their bare clips catching a cold cyan glow. A thick glowing red neon ring circles the row of empty holders and its light spills red onto the steam. On the left, chest-up behind the counter, a Korean cafeteria cook in a white coat and cap grips a ladle, brow drawn into a hard V, jaw muscles visibly clenched, lips pressed into a thin line as he looks at the empty holders. The upper frame is packed with hanging heat lamps, stacked trays and ventilation ducts. no text, no letters, no words, no numbers, no watermark.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 제목 약속의 정면 이행 — 20kg 포장쌀에는 국가명이 붙고, 떡·쌀과자·식혜에는 그 칸이 비어 있다. 확정 제목의 '원산지를 확인해도 국가명이 없다'가 마트 진열대 하나로 읽히게 좌우 대비를 골랐다.
thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the lower two-fifths of this image is one clean continuous surface — plain polished supermarket floor — rendered simply and evenly with nothing on it, and every subject, character, object, effect and action is composed entirely within the upper three-fifths above it. photorealistic advertising composite, intense neon glow lighting, emissive colors spilling onto surrounding surfaces, extreme color contrast, the upper three-fifths densely packed with elements, exaggerated wide-angle perspective, hyper-saturated and eye-catching. A Korean supermarket aisle split down the middle: the entire left shelf is stacked with 20kg rice sacks each carrying a large clearly printed origin panel and a small Chinese flag emblem (red field with one large yellow star and four smaller yellow stars), bathed in acid-lime shelf lighting; the entire right shelf is crammed with glossy puffed rice snack pouches, vacuum-packed rice cake sticks and bottles of sikhye whose origin panels are all left blank white, and a bold red neon ring sweeps around that blank row, spilling glowing red onto the plastic packaging. In the right foreground, chest-up beside a stroller, a young Korean father turns a snack pouch over in both hands, eyebrows knitted hard down, eyes narrowed at the blank panel, lower lip caught between his teeth. Shelves, price rails and ceiling lights fill the upper frame densely into exaggerated wide-angle perspective. no text, no letters, no words, no numbers, no watermark.

thumbnails.concept_ko: '확인해도 없다'를 확인 행위 자체로 보여주는 컷. 돋보기 너머 원산지 칸이 백지라는 그림이 제목의 미해결 모순을 즉시 전달한다. 대본 엔딩의 라벨 판별 기준 파트가 근거.

A huge round magnifying glass fills the centre-right of the frame, held up against the back of a glossy rice snack pouch; through the lens the ingredient panel is enormously magnified and one rectangular origin field is completely blank white, ringed by a thick glowing red neon circle whose light bleeds through the glass onto the fingers. Behind, a cold cyan-white kitchen counter is densely packed with more rice cake packs, sikhye bottles and instant rice cups stacked into wide-angle depth under acid-lime under-cabinet lighting. On the left, chest-up, a Korean woman in her thirties leans in over the lens, one eye squeezed nearly shut and the other wide, mouth slightly open in disbelief, her free hand pressed flat on the counter. no text, no letters, no words, no numbers, no watermark.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 제목의 '15만 7천 톤'이 실제로 들어오는 장면. 컨테이너에서 쏟아지는 쌀과 그 옆에서 백지로 흘러나오는 라벨 띠를 한 프레임에 놓아 숫자와 빈 칸을 한 번에 연결했다. 검역관을 세워 우리 쪽 시점을 유지했다.

A night container quay under a deep navy sky: a shipping container painted with the Chinese flag (red field with one large yellow star and four smaller yellow stars) is tipped open and a torrent of white rice pours out in mid-motion, lit from below by acid-lime floodlights, while directly beside it an industrial printer unspools a long ribbon of food labels whose origin fields are all blank white, the ribbon whipping in the wind with a thick red neon glow running along its edge. Gantry cranes, stacked containers and mooring lights pack the upper frame into exaggerated wide-angle perspective. On the right, chest-up, a Korean quarantine officer in a reflective vest, mask and gloves holds a glass sample jar of rice up toward the floodlight, eyes narrowed to slits, jaw set hard, the other hand steadying the jar. no text, no letters, no words, no numbers, no watermark.

thumbnails.composition: 좌 1/3 인물 + 우 2/3 현장 (앵커 002 인과 배치 계승)
thumbnails.concept_ko: 앵커 002의 구도 골격을 계승한 장. 계승 항목 = 화면 분할(좌 1/3 인물 클로즈업 + 우 2/3 현장), 시선 흐름(인물 정면 응시 → 우측 현장 → 하단 텍스트 블록), 요소 크기 관계(인물 세로 절반). 다르게 한 것 5개 = ① 피사체(폐수 탱크·냉각탑·갈라진 논 → 식품 포장 라인·라벨 프린터·빈 칸 과자 봉지) ② 색(붉은 오렌지 노을 단일톤 → 차가운 청백색 공장 톤) ③ 시점(지평선 아이레벨 → 컨베이어 하이앵글) ④ 강조 요소(지면 균열·흘러나오는 폐수 → 빈 칸을 감싸는 붉은 네온 링·인쇄되는 라벨 띠) ⑤ 인물 감정 방향(쉿 제스처=입막음 → 서류를 앞으로 밀어 놓는 손=결재·승인).
thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the lower two-fifths of this image is one clean continuous surface — plain polished factory floor — rendered simply and evenly with nothing on it, and every subject, character, object, effect and action is composed entirely within the upper three-fifths above it. photorealistic advertising composite, intense neon glow lighting, emissive colors spilling onto surrounding surfaces, extreme color contrast, the upper three-fifths densely packed with elements, exaggerated wide-angle perspective, hyper-saturated and eye-catching. High camera angle looking down along a conveyor. The left third of the frame is occupied by Xi Jinping (President of China) in a dark suit, waist-up, completely deadpan and staring straight into the camera with flat unblinking eyes, mouth closed in a neutral line, one hand flat on a single sheet of paper that he is pushing forward across a desk edge toward the viewer. The right two thirds is a cold cyan-white food packaging plant seen from above, densely packed with a running conveyor of puffed rice snack pouches and vacuum-packed rice cakes, an overhead label printer laying a ribbon of labels onto them; on the nearest pouch the rectangular origin field is left completely blank white and a thick bold red neon ring burns around it, its glow spilling red across the plastic and the steel rollers, with acid-lime fluorescent tubes overhead. no text, no letters, no words, no numbers, no watermark.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 우리 쪽 얼굴로 잡은 첫 클로즈업. 002 댓글 9위 '아이들과 전쟁 중'(32)이 가리키는 부모 프레임이 근거이며, 시청자 이입점을 상대가 아니라 우리 쪽에 둔다. 표정만으로 '아이 간식 봉지에 국가명이 없다'가 읽히게 눈·입·손을 분해했다.
thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the lower two-fifths of this image is one clean continuous surface — plain out-of-focus supermarket floor — rendered simply and evenly with nothing on it, and every subject, character, object, effect and action is composed entirely within the upper three-fifths above it. photorealistic advertising composite, intense neon glow lighting, emissive colors spilling onto surrounding surfaces, extreme color contrast, the upper three-fifths densely packed with elements, exaggerated wide-angle perspective, hyper-saturated and eye-catching. Tight chest-up close-up of a Korean mother in her late thirties, her face filling the left half of the frame, lit hard by acid-lime shelf lighting: pupils shrunk to pinpricks, eyebrows driven into a sharp V, nostrils flared, mouth open in an angry half-shout, a flush rising on her cheeks. She grips two children's puffed rice snack pouches, one in each raised hand, thrusting the nearer one toward the camera so its blank white origin field faces the lens with a thick red neon ring burning around it. Behind her the supermarket snack shelves recede into densely packed wide-angle blur under cold cyan light. no text, no letters, no words, no numbers, no watermark.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 8번과 감정 온도를 갈랐다. 분노가 아니라 경멸·헛웃음으로, 대본 P8에서 '허락한 건 우리 쪽 문서'라는 사실을 들었을 때 나오는 반응이다. 우리 쪽 얼굴 클로즈업 두 번째 장이라 세트가 상대 시점으로 닫히지 않는다.
